title: Appeals and Grievances Casebook: Inpatient Cost-Share Percentage on Days Carried to a Second-Level Reconsideration
content:
## Casebook — Appeals and Grievances: percentage on the days carried

Scope: a second-level reconsideration asked for on a decided Medical Necessity Reconsideration of an inpatient mental health authorization.

**Rule.** The cost-share percentage on the days carried follows the facility's network status recorded on the stay's lines and the inpatient schedule of the tier the stay is billed under: a non-network facility under a tier whose non-network inpatient basis takes a percentage of the allowed amount carries that tier's non-network inpatient percentage; a network facility under a tier whose network inpatient basis is the lesser of a daily charge and a percentage carries that tier's network inpatient percentage; any other carries no percentage.

The tier is the TRICARE Select tier of the enrollment the stay is billed under; its inpatient bases and percentages are the figures in the TRICARE Select schedule. A non-network inpatient basis takes a percentage of the allowed amount when it is a percentage-of-allowed basis or a lesser-of basis comparing a daily charge with a percentage. "Non-network" covers a facility recorded as non-network, participating or nonparticipating.

| Hypothetical case | Facility | Tier's basis for that status | Judgement | Percentage |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | network | lesser of a daily charge and 20 percent | network facility, lesser-of basis | 20 percent |
| 2 | network | daily charge with a minimum | any other | none |
| 3 | non-network participating | 25 percent of the allowed amount | non-network, percentage basis | 25 percent |
| 4 | non-network nonparticipating | daily charge with a minimum | any other | none |
